k: A barrel of hymnals, swollen with rain into a single block of paper. The top one is open to "Rest Ye, Dawn-Bound."
src: 'A barrel of hymnals, swollen with rain into a single block of paper. The top one is open to "Rest Ye, Dawn-Bound."'

k: A ward of crystallized light hums around the mainmast. Up close you can hear it: the hymn, over and over, the same eight bars.
src: 'A ward of crystallized light hums around the mainmast. Up close you can hear it: the hymn, over and over, the same eight bars.'

k: Crow's nest
src: 'Crow\'s nest'

k: The crow's nest has snapped off and rolled to this islet. You climb into it. From up here, through the rain, the shards wheel slowly around a single point of light.
src: 'The crow\'s nest has snapped off and rolled to this islet. You climb into it. From up here, through the rain, the shards wheel slowly around a single point of light.'

k: The point of light does not wheel. It sits in the middle of everything, perfectly still.
src: 'The point of light does not wheel. It sits in the middle of everything, perfectly still.'

k: Log
src: 'Log'

k: The captain's bunk, made with corners you could cut bread with. Under the pillow: a pressed flower and a list of hymns, with "Rest Ye" underlined twice.
src: 'The captain\'s bunk, made with corners you could cut bread with. Under the pillow: a pressed flower and a list of hymns, with "Rest Ye" underlined twice.'

k: A crack in the rock runs all the way up through the shard. At the top, impossibly far, a sliver of sky.
src: 'A crack in the rock runs all the way up through the shard. At the top, impossibly far, a sliver of sky.'

k: Through it, every so often, the shards drift past in a slow procession — and in the middle of them all, one white point that never moves at all.
src: 'Through it, every so often, the shards drift past in a slow procession — and in the middle of them all, one white point that never moves at all.'

k: An ember crystal as tall as Bram. Inside it, very small, a shape like a bird with its wings spread, caught mid-flight.
src: 'An ember crystal as tall as Bram. Inside it, very small, a shape like a bird with its wings spread, caught mid-flight.'

k: Aunt Odessa says to give you the family discount. We don't have a family discount. She says to invent one.
src: 'Aunt Odessa says to give you the family discount. We don\'t have a family discount. She says to invent one.'

k: The Ledger Exchange. Everything's for sale, and everything's written down. Aunt Odessa's rule.
src: 'The Ledger Exchange. Everything\'s for sale, and everything\'s written down. Aunt Odessa\'s rule.'

k: Ferry
src: 'Ferry'

k: I saw him shoot the line. From up here, I saw it.
src: 'I saw him shoot the line. From up here, I saw it.'

k: Tell him— no. Don't tell him anything. Just tell him Gemma says the paint's still ugly.
src: 'Tell him— no. Don\'t tell him anything. Just tell him Gemma says the paint\'s still ugly.'

k: He went up the plank? He actually went *up* it?
src: 'He went up the plank? He actually went *up* it?'

k: I crewed the Halcyon six years. I left when he turned east. Maybe I'll come back when he turns around.
src: 'I crewed the Halcyon six years. I left when he turned east. Maybe I\'ll come back when he turns around.'

k: I was his bosun, once. Best crew in the sky.
src: 'I was his bosun, once. Best crew in the sky.'

k: When the sea went up, we had the engines hot and the kids' island in sight. He looked at it for a long time. Then he said "east."
src: 'When the sea went up, we had the engines hot and the kids\' island in sight. He looked at it for a long time. Then he said "east."'

k: I got off at the first rock we came to. Haven't spoken to him since.
src: 'I got off at the first rock we came to. Haven\'t spoken to him since.'

k: Stormsilk. You brought back stormsilk.
src: 'Stormsilk. You brought back stormsilk.'

k: My Arlo flew a silk-rigger. Could I— no. No, it's for your ship. Just let me look at it a moment.
src: 'My Arlo flew a silk-rigger. Could I— no. No, it\'s for your ship. Just let me look at it a moment.'

k: ...Thank you. It still smells of weather.
src: '...Thank you. It still smells of weather.'

k: I knit with sailcloth. It's all that falls out of the sky now — sails, and the people who were under them.
src: 'I knit with sailcloth. It\'s all that falls out of the sky now — sails, and the people who were under them.'

k: My Arlo went up the morning the sun broke. I keep knitting him scarves. I've got eleven. He'll be ever so warm.
src: 'My Arlo went up the morning the sun broke. I keep knitting him scarves. I\'ve got eleven. He\'ll be ever so warm.'

k: The Noon Spire. Of course it was the Spire.
src: 'The Noon Spire. Of course it was the Spire.'

k: I sang in the Choir for twenty years. There is nothing I want to say to the Hierophant that a hymn would carry.
src: 'I sang in the Choir for twenty years. There is nothing I want to say to the Hierophant that a hymn would carry.'

k: I was a Cantor of the Choir. I took off the robe the night the sun broke. Kept the hood. It's cold.
src: 'I was a Cantor of the Choir. I took off the robe the night the sun broke. Kept the hood. It\'s cold.'

k: Pilgrims still fly north, you know. To a white tower on the brightest shard. They say inside it is always the afternoon of a summer festival, and the dead are there, waiting.
src: 'Pilgrims still fly north, you know. To a white tower on the brightest shard. They say inside it is always the afternoon of a summer festival, and the dead are there, waiting.'

k: They say a great many things. The pilgrims don't come back to say otherwise.
src: 'They say a great many things. The pilgrims don\'t come back to say otherwise.'

k: Bird stew! Bird stew! Don't ask what bird. I don't ask the birds what you are.
src: 'Bird stew! Bird stew! Don\'t ask what bird. I don\'t ask the birds what you are.'

k: There used to be seagulls, you know. Before. I miss complaining about them.
src: 'There used to be seagulls, you know. Before. I miss complaining about them.'

k: We came from the Mirefen shards. Walked the sky-bridges, three weeks.
src: 'We came from the Mirefen shards. Walked the sky-bridges, three weeks.'

k: Nia sleeps fine now. I don't. Somebody has to listen for the bridges creaking.
src: 'Nia sleeps fine now. I don\'t. Somebody has to listen for the bridges creaking.'

k: You're going to try. You said. I heard you.
src: 'You\'re going to try. You said. I heard you.'

k: Are you the girl from the song? The one with the red hair?
src: 'Are you the girl from the song? The one with the red hair?'

k: Did you really break the sun?
src: 'Did you really break the sun?'

k: Yes. I did.
src: 'Yes. I did.'

k: Can you fix it?
src: 'Can you fix it?'

k: I'm going to try.
src: 'I\'m going to try.'

k: The song doesn't say that part. Somebody should put it in.
src: 'The song doesn\'t say that part. Somebody should put it in.'

k: Lift's yours, with Mags's key. Mind the bottom — it bites.
src: 'Lift\'s yours, with Mags\'s key. Mind the bottom — it bites.'

k: Not the lift. The Boneyard. The lift's very well behaved.
src: 'Not the lift. The Boneyard. The lift\'s very well behaved.'

k: Lift's chained. Mags keeps the key. Mags keeps everything.
src: 'Lift\'s chained. Mags keeps the key. Mags keeps everything.'

k: Down there's the Boneyard. Everything that fell out of the sky. Some of it's still moving.
src: 'Down there\'s the Boneyard. Everything that fell out of the sky. Some of it\'s still moving.'

k: The skiff
src: 'The skiff'

k: An empty mooring post. The cut line trails over the edge into nothing.
src: 'An empty mooring post. The cut line trails over the edge into nothing.'

k: Corvin's skiff: a one-man sky-boat, sleek and patched, moored to the Lip by a single line.
src: 'Corvin\'s skiff: a one-man sky-boat, sleek and patched, moored to the Lip by a single line.'

k: Its tank is full. Someone has been keeping it full.
src: 'Its tank is full. Someone has been keeping it full.'

k: The bow
src: 'The bow'

k: Ash, and the long scar in it where a ship used to lie.
src: 'Ash, and the long scar in it where a ship used to lie.'

k: HALCYON, in chipped gold leaf. Below it, smaller, an older name has been painted over. You can just make out the first letters: H-A-L.
src: 'HALCYON, in chipped gold leaf. Below it, smaller, an older name has been painted over. You can just make out the first letters: H-A-L.'

k: A campfire of kite-sticks and chair legs. Someone has drawn a ship in the ash beside it, with a very large flag and a very small captain.
src: 'A campfire of kite-sticks and chair legs. Someone has drawn a ship in the ash beside it, with a very large flag and a very small captain.'

k: A table made from a door. The chart on it is mostly blank, with careful notes in the margins: HERE BE NOTHING. HERE TOO. HERE, POSSIBLY, SOUP.
src: 'A table made from a door. The chart on it is mostly blank, with careful notes in the margins: HERE BE NOTHING. HERE TOO. HERE, POSSIBLY, SOUP.'

k: Kite-tails and prayer-flags snap on the lines. Someone has stitched names onto them. Dozens of names. Under the newest: COME HOME.
src: 'Kite-tails and prayer-flags snap on the lines. Someone has stitched names onto them. Dozens of names. Under the newest: COME HOME.'

k: Ox's anvil, scattered with clock-hands. Dozens of them, all pointing different ways.
src: 'Ox\'s anvil, scattered with clock-hands. Dozens of them, all pointing different ways.'

k: The lift winch. A chalk tally on its housing counts the people who went down to the Boneyard this year. A second tally counts the ones who came up. The second one is shorter.
src: 'The lift winch. A chalk tally on its housing counts the people who went down to the Boneyard this year. A second tally counts the ones who came up. The second one is shorter.'

k: The stocks. Someone has carved, very small, into the wood: THE GOAT WAS A DOG.
src: 'The stocks. Someone has carved, very small, into the wood: THE GOAT WAS A DOG.'

k: Lift's chained. Mags has the key.
src: 'Lift\'s chained. Mags has the key.'

k: Not yet. We came here for a ship.
src: 'Not yet. We came here for a ship.'

k: You... got a coil. Out of the Boneyard.
src: 'You... got a coil. Out of the Boneyard.'

k: ...Go show Mags. She'll be insufferable. Let her.
src: '...Go show Mags. She\'ll be insufferable. Let her.'

k: Mags. Wreck. Up the canyon. I'm not coming.
src: 'Mags. Wreck. Up the canyon. I\'m not coming.'

k: Don't look at me like that, sparrow. Your mother used to look at me like that.
src: 'Don\'t look at me like that, sparrow. Your mother used to look at me like that.'

k: Inn
src: 'Inn'

k: Beds upstairs. Two hundred. The Captain's old room's free — first time in a year he isn't sleeping on my bar.
src: 'Beds upstairs. Two hundred. The Captain\'s old room\'s free — first time in a year he isn\'t sleeping on my bar.'

k: Beds upstairs, two hundred a night. Breakfast is whatever Marta caught. Don't ask what.
src: 'Beds upstairs, two hundred a night. Breakfast is whatever Marta caught. Don\'t ask what.'

k: the Last Call
src: 'the Last Call'

k: Zzz... five more minutes...
src: 'Zzz... five more minutes...'

k: ...five more years...
src: '...five more years...'

k: Bottles, labeled in Tuck's square hand: NOT FOR CORVIN. One new label, the ink still wet: STILL NOT FOR CORVIN. GOOD.
src: 'Bottles, labeled in Tuck\'s square hand: NOT FOR CORVIN. One new label, the ink still wet: STILL NOT FOR CORVIN. GOOD.'

k: Bottles, mostly empty, all labeled in Tuck's square hand: NOT FOR CORVIN.
src: 'Bottles, mostly empty, all labeled in Tuck\'s square hand: NOT FOR CORVIN.'

k: A card table. The felt is worn through in exactly one place: where the dealer's left hand rests.
src: 'A card table. The felt is worn through in exactly one place: where the dealer\'s left hand rests.'
